style.prompt: Create an 8-second vertical 9:16 event promo for Lantern Night. No voiceover, no dialogue, no audio. Beautiful warm glowing paper lanterns floating above an atmospheric park at night, deep midnight-blue sky, amber and gold lights, subtle drifting particles, elegant cinematic lighting. Gentle camera push-in, smooth lantern motion. Prioritize extremely clear, large, stable typography for the entire 8 seconds, centered in safe margins, high contrast warm-white lettering over a dark uncluttered central area. Display exactly these three lines, spelled precisely, with no additional text: 'Lantern Night' (largest headline, upper middle), '14 November 2026' (large, center), 'Willow Park, Bristol' (large, below). All three lines must be big, immediately readable on a phone, fully visible throughout, and never cropped, obscured or distorted. Polished premium community-event poster brought to life, balanced composition, subtle fade in and fade out.
